property_summary: For any admissible balance on c, calling sudicideAnyone as the owner must destroy c and route its entire remaining balance to the caller (msg.sender), never to the zero address; the mutant instead sends the full balance to address(0), so the zero address's balance increases, breaking the rule.
change_summary: Change selfdestruct recipient from msg.sender to address(0), sending the remaining balance to the zero address instead of the caller.
